# SEO / GEO / ASO implementation report (2 November 2026)

## 1. Architecture decision

The app's web build is a client-rendered single page (`web.output: "single"`) and almost everything in it is behind login and contains private matrimonial data. Converting it to server/static rendering would risk login, OTP, PIN, biodata, discovery, boost and payment flows, and would not make sense for private screens anyway.

**Smallest compatible change:** a separate, pre-rendered public website in `website/` (plain HTML generated by a zero-dependency Node script), and the web app made explicitly non-indexable.

Recommended hosting topology:

| Host | Serves | Indexing |
|---|---|---|
| `https://www.<domain>` | `website/dist` (static, any static host: Cloudflare Pages / Netlify / EAS Hosting / S3) | Indexed |
| `https://app.<domain>` | `dist` from `expo export --platform web` | `noindex` + robots `Disallow: /` |
| `<domain>` (apex) | 301 → `https://www.<domain>` | — |

## 2. Commands

```bash
npm run site:build                         # preview build (noindex, robots blocks all)
SITE_URL=https://www.<domain> APP_URL=https://app.<domain> npm run site:check   # production build + validation
npm run store:check                        # store listing limits
```

Optional env: `PLAY_URL`, `APP_STORE_URL` (store links + MobileApplication schema), `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN`, `GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION`, `BING_SITE_VERIFICATION`, `SAME_AS` (comma-separated official social URLs), `CONTACT_EMAIL`, `PUBLICATION_FREE=0`, `AI_TRAINING=0`.

## 5. Technical SEO implemented

- Unique title, description, single H1, semantic H2/H3, canonical, robots meta, Open Graph + Twitter card, theme colour, icons on every page.
- `sitemap.xml` (public pages only, `lastmod`), `robots.txt` (crawler policy + sitemap), `blog/feed.xml` (RSS), `llms.txt`, `404.html` (noindex).
- Trailing-slash directory URLs everywhere (one canonical form). Host must 301 the apex and `http` to `https://www.`.
- Preview safety: without `SITE_URL`, every page is `noindex` and robots blocks all; `_headers` also sends `X-Robots-Tag`.
- `_headers`: security headers (CSP with a hash for the inlined stylesheet), long cache for fonts/images.
- Breadcrumbs (HTML + JSON-LD), internal links from every page, related guides on every article.

## 6. Structured data validation

`node website/check.mjs` (production build, example domain): **26 pages checked, 25 sitemap URLs, PASSED** — every JSON-LD block parses, has `@type`, and contains no ratings/reviews/offers; one H1 per page; unique titles and descriptions; canonicals match; all internal links resolve; all images have `alt`, `width`, `height`; no phone-number patterns; sitemap has only existing, indexable, public URLs. Google Rich Results Test / Schema validator need the live URL (manual, after launch).

## 10. Analytics setup

1. **Google Search Console:** add a Domain property for `<domain>` (DNS TXT) or set `GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION`; submit `https://www.<domain>/sitemap.xml`.
2. **Bing Webmaster Tools:** import from Search Console or set `BING_SITE_VERIFICATION`; submit the sitemap. (Bing data also feeds Copilot/ChatGPT search visibility.)
3. **Website analytics:** recommended **Cloudflare Web Analytics** (cookieless, no consent banner needed) → set `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN`. GA4 / GTM / Microsoft Clarity are **not** added by default: they set cookies or record sessions and need a consent banner under DPDP-style consent; add only with a consent mechanism and never on the app (member data).
4. **App funnel** (already measurable from the database, counts only — run as an admin in Supabase SQL):

```sql
with u as (select id from app_users where role = 'user' and created_at > now() - interval '30 days')
select count(*) as signed_up_and_verified,
       count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from profiles p where p.user_id = u.id)) as started_biodata,
       count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from profiles p where p.user_id = u.id and p.published_at is not null)) as published,
       count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from shortlists s where s.user_id = u.id)
                           or exists (select 1 from contact_requests r where r.from_user_id = u.id)) as first_discovery_action
from u;
```
   Website CTA clicks → (website analytics). Install attribution → Play Console with UTM'd store links. **Not yet built:** passing the website's UTM source into the app sign-up (would need an app change + one column); planned in 90_DAY_GROWTH_PLAN.md.
5. **Play Console / App Store Connect:** store listing acquisition and conversion after the listings go live.

No analytics event may contain names, numbers, biodata fields or free text (existing app rule: `analytics_events.props` never stores numbers or text).

## 12. Issues that could prevent indexing

- No domain/hosting yet (nothing can be indexed until deployed).
- Building without `SITE_URL` → everything `noindex` (by design for previews).
- Host not serving `404.html` with a real 404 status, or serving the site on both apex and www without a 301 (duplicate content).
- A brand-new domain has no links: expect weeks before stable rankings; earn local links and mentions.
- If the web app is deployed on the same host path as the site, its `robots.txt` (`Disallow: /`) would block the site — keep them on separate hosts.
- Very competitive head terms (Muslim matrimony India, Muslim matrimonial app) are dominated by national brands; local and long-tail clusters are the realistic first wins.
